Container.Name: folderframe
Container.Overview: FolderFrame is a folder-based photo and video gallery with album browsing and slideshows, served by Caddy. Select a dedicated media folder; it is mounted read-only. Configuration and generated thumbnails are stored separately in appdata. Thumbnail generation is enabled by default for faster galleries. Anyone who can reach the WebUI can download its media. No authentication or TLS is configured. Use on a trusted LAN, or add access controls before public exposure. Do not select an entire share, source repository, private files, or a folder containing symlinks. Learn more: https://www.folderframe.com/

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Choose an unused host port for the gallery.

Config.Name: Media Folder
Config.Description: Select an existing dedicated gallery folder. Read-only does not prevent downloads. Do not select a whole share or repository.

Config.Name: Appdata Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent FolderFrame configuration. The default JSON file is created automatically on first start.

Config.Name: Generate Thumbnails
Config.Description: Generate persistent 480px WebP previews in appdata for faster galleries. Originals remain read-only. Set false to disable.

Config.Name: Thumbnail Scan Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between incremental thumbnail scans (60-86400). Existing current previews are skipped.

Config.Name: Source Label
Config.Description: Optional label for the mounted media source. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Starting View
Config.Description: Optional starting view: folders or all. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Default Sort
Config.Description: Optional default sort: filename, newest, or oldest. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Slideshow Interval
Config.Description: Optional photo duration in seconds: 3, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 300, 900, or 3600. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Image Display Mode
Config.Description: Optional image sizing: fit or original. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Start Automatically
Config.Description: Optional slideshow startup: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Shuffle by Default
Config.Description: Optional shuffle default: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Gallery Refresh Interval
Config.Description: Optional gallery rescan interval from 1 to 86400 seconds. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Embed Refresh Interval
Config.Description: Optional embed rescan interval from 1 to 86400 seconds. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.

Config.Name: Remember Browser Preferences
Config.Description: Optional preference persistence: true or false. Blank uses folderframe.config.json.
